items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I’d have to talk to my buddy Coach [Michael Conner]

ctx.x: How about if you got a call to do a four month tour as a live mixer for Steely Dan?
Oh well yeah. That — I’d be all over that. I’d have to talk to my buddy Coach [Michael Conner] who is their live front house guy. Yeah.
You could switch chairs with him, put him on SNL.
